title: ATC adaptation study
metric_contract: Standalone normalized WER: lowercase, Unicode diacritic fold, punctuation and symbol removal, and whitespace normalization. Lower is better.

program_policy.training: Only the isolated 0.418-hour gold training split may provide ATCO2 supervision.
program_policy.development: The 0.100-hour gold development split is used for checkpoint and recipe selection.
program_policy.community_test: The 2.000-hour community test remains locked and is never used for training or selection.
program_policy.general_replay: General English may be used only as replay data and as a forgetting guardrail.
program_policy.silver_status: Silver ATCO2 is frozen as historical evidence and is excluded from all new training, tuning, and selection decisions.

summary.best_run: G3 silver → gold refinement · seed 42 · beam 4

findings.title: Silver scale plateaued early
findings.text: Nemotron improved sharply with the first 10 hours, but 50–314.7 hours stayed near 43–45% WER at the original 3e-5 learning rate.

findings.title: Learning rate unlocked ATC specialization
findings.text: Raising Nemotron to 1e-4 reached 32.85% ATC WER, but LibriSpeech deteriorated to 16.88%; optimization and forgetting had to be treated together.

findings.title: English replay protected general ASR
findings.text: Balanced replay held LibriSpeech near the untouched baseline for both Nemotron and Parakeet while preserving substantial ATC gains.

findings.title: Architecture mattered
findings.text: Parakeet variants learned the ATC domain more effectively than the initial Nemotron scale runs, but ATC-only Parakeet CTC also suffered severe forgetting.

findings.title: Gold was most valuable as a refinement
findings.text: Starting from the silver-adapted Parakeet TDT checkpoint and refining on only 0.418 hours of gold plus English reduced locked gold-test WER from 30.28% to 20.00%.

findings.title: The result reproduced across seeds
findings.text: G3 reached 20.51% with seed 1234 and 20.00% with seed 42. G4 was similarly stable but consistently weaker, supporting a recipe effect rather than a lucky seed.

findings.title: Beam search delivered a measured final-mile gain
findings.text: Beam-4 decoding reduced locked community-test WER from 20.00% to 19.08%. A paired bootstrap interval excluded zero, while LibriSpeech remained effectively unchanged.

findings.title: Averaging beat targeted reweighting and generic noise
findings.text: The top-three G3 average reached 18.77% on gold development. Its frozen locked-test pass reached 19.21%, slightly behind seed-42 beam-4 at 19.08%, so averaging improved the selection set but did not establish a new locked-test frontier.

findings.title: Phrase boosting did not help this TDT checkpoint
findings.text: A training-text-only 200-phrase sweep selected ordinary beam-4 with alpha 0. MALSD started at 19.40% development WER and degraded monotonically to 24.73% as boosting increased; the unboosted beam result remained 18.77%.
